facts.fact: The operator's own page describes LSK IX in Lusaka as Zambia's neutral, non-profit exchange where ISPs and network operators interconnect, with 14+ networks connected and public peering and route server services running; the page is undated, so its retrieval date 2026-08-29 is used.
Traffic: 2.8 Tbps (peak) at LSK IX on 2026-08-29, as the operator's page states ("2.8 Tbps Peak Traffic Handled"); the page is undated and gives no date for the peak, so the retrieval date is used.

note: The page offers hosting for caches and CDNs but names no content network present, so no content fact.
